target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one vCPU, graphical terminal with emulated keyboard
result: failure on second of three 54-character entries at 0.15-second nominal pacing
observed: The first entry had the expected visible text and length. After Down cleared its input buffer, the second entry reported length 54, but the visible document retained a prefix of the first line ahead of the second. The faster 0.05-second cases were not reached.

after.result: Six repeated 54-character lines passed visible text and buffer-length checks at nominal 0.15 and 0.05 second key pacing, with a clear between lines. A separate long command produced the exact expected formatted output. A second wrapped line was replaced using Up, and the recalled command produced a second result. The terminal then evaluated 40+2 as 42. Two-terminal typing, history and prompt recovery also passed.

limits: The input diagnostic measures length, not exact contents. The visible test covers the checked string and rates; it does not prove all keyboard events are reliable. No live UTM or physical Pi test was performed.
